text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Without misreading the clock, 
accidentally wearing someone else's shoes, 
or tripping over anything—"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I actually managed to get to 
schoooool~~...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Could this, c-c-could this be a harbinger 
of a super blunder...?!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...I-I feel like I'm going to bump into 
someone and hurt them soon..." + "ｕ...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-And because of an injury, they can't 
chase their dreams anymore, and it 
completely derails their entire life~~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, uuu... S-So sorryy... Please let me 
spend the rest of my life making it up to 
youuu...

Meisho Doto ended up feeling down after 
imagining troubles that hadn't even 
happened.
